page.content:
Jurassic Solnhofen fossil that first tied birds to dinosaurs.

How Archaeopteryx connects

  • Location: Solnhofen — Archaeopteryx fossils come from the Solnhofen limestone.
  • Topic: Theropoda — Archaeopteryx also sits on the theropod line that becomes birds.
  • Topic: Birds — Archaeopteryx is the first well-known stem bird.

What is Archaeopteryx?

Archaeopteryx, from Bavarian lagoon limestones, has flight feathers and teeth, a transitional fossil Owen's successors used to argue that birds are dinosaurs.

Key threads lead to Solnhofen, Theropoda and Birds.
